allowed_claim: Physical state factors, the sets of actions, disturbances and outcomes, and finite check objects are finite and exact. Runs, histories, event registers, future words, and the observations reporting unbounded counters (order, progress, records) may be unbounded; results about them are proved by invariants and induction in Lean, not by enumeration. In results about transport between systems, source and target are distinct systems fixed before evaluation.
assumptions_and_scope: Unbounded objects include: TTH-03 future words; TTH-06/TTH-07 run spaces; TTS-04 event registers; TTF-05 growing histories with universal full-history lifting.
blocked_stronger_claim: Every object is a finite enumerated state space; the results apply to physical substrates or to unrestricted infinite systems.

allowed_claim: The temporal signature carried through an episode has eight fields: the predictive present, order, tick phase, genuine progress, an endogenous record arrow, route memory, maintenance state and owner. It is fixed before, and independently of, any lineage verdict.
assumptions_and_scope: Definition; carries no result.
blocked_stronger_claim: The signature is a complete account of experienced time.

allowed_claim: Continuation onto a different system splits into three separately checked questions: does the target realize the conditions, does the episode continue through live-overlap handoffs with no gap, and does the target maintain itself after the source and every transfer aid are withdrawn? Immediate direct succession is a fourth, separate mode.
assumptions_and_scope: Framing. With operational autonomy, the three conclusions are proved logically independent (TTH-06 O version). With package-preserving autonomy, autonomy includes realization by construction (TTH-06 F version, which proves autonomy implies realization).
blocked_stronger_claim: Endpoint similarity settles any of the three questions; lineage implies realization or autonomy; realization implies lineage.

allowed_claim: Claims are of four kinds: structural results proved in Lean, finite countermodels checked in Lean, interpretive hypotheses, and ontological postulates. A result of one kind never supplies a claim of another kind.
assumptions_and_scope: Stated once, in the setting section.
blocked_stronger_claim: Structural results establish recognition, consciousness or identity.

allowed_claim: The eight conditions of the closure architecture are taken from the companion architecture paper and recalled briefly. Each result records the grade at which each condition holds: design grade, or a simplified surrogate that the paper describes.
assumptions_and_scope: The cross-paper wording of grades is settled in W6.
blocked_stronger_claim: A surrogate-grade condition is the architecture's condition.

allowed_claim: We prove that a valid strict-continuation certificate yields three conclusions, each from its own check: the target realizes the specified conditions, the episode is a strict live-overlap lineage, and the target is autonomous after withdrawal. There are two versions. In the package-preserving version (F), autonomy includes the realization check, and we prove that it implies realization. In the operational version (O), the three conclusions are logically independent: on the two-copy model, each one can fail while the other two hold. The top-level soundness proof assembles three content lemmas: realization from gluing local assignments along running-intersection paths, temporal transport from a one-step lumping argument extended to all words, and autonomy from an invariant certificate turned into a strategy by induction on plays. The prose must present these lemmas as the mathematical content.
assumptions_and_scope: Typed primitive cells; system, action, event and route interfaces; independently checked stage and cover data. Autonomy acquisition uses historical source support, while lineage uses funded actual source execution. Nominal disturbances, with every positive-support branch covered; no resource-shock robustness. The selected-response sparse format (StrictSparse) is representation-sensitive. For the defined game semantics, autonomy is equivalent to the existence of a proof-bearing invariant certificate (a semantic existence theorem, not an effective search procedure); the finite-factor constructor is sound but potentially incomplete, so its failure to produce a certificate does not show that autonomy fails. Route readout is route-indexed. Recognition is not addressed.
blocked_stronger_claim: The certificate establishes identity, survival, consciousness, or robustness to resource shocks; the top-level soundness theorem is itself the deep result (it is assembly; the content is in the three lemmas); all eight true/false patterns of the three conclusions are exhibited (only the three single-lane failures are).

allowed_claim: On a finite two-copy model built from the companion paper's deadline system, a strict-continuation certificate passes. One system-changing handoff therefore exhibits realization on the target, strict lineage, and autonomy after withdrawal together. Conditions (4)-(7) hold there only in simplified form.
assumptions_and_scope: A single system-changing leg. Both gates pass on the same baseline assignment. Autonomy acquisition uses historical source support, while lineage uses funded execution. Nominal disturbances. A reversed-history instance also passes.
condition_grades: (1)-(3) substantive from the deadline system; (8) substantive operational viability; (4)-(7) surrogate
blocked_stronger_claim: The instance meets all eight conditions at design grade; it is a multi-hop chain.

allowed_claim: On a model with an eight-state physical factor and unbounded registers, a two-hop chain through three distinct systems passes: each hop is a strict handoff whose middle system's whole signature agrees literally between the hops, with funded autonomy at the intermediate and final systems and full eight-field transport for all finite words. The composite lineage is the conjunction of the two hops' lineages. (The general composition of strict legs into a chain is TTH-04.)
assumptions_and_scope: Historical mixed support; unit disturbances; six removed roles aliased; receiver ignores history and route selectors; route-indexed; no flatness inference.
condition_grades: (1) genuine nonuniform fixed point; (2) computed factorization split; (3) recursive profile 2-4-4; (8) computed greatest viability, empty after a recharge cut; (4)-(7) surrogate
blocked_stronger_claim: A general composition theorem for full handoff certificates in which interface agreement does work (the generic composition statement does not use its interface-agreement hypothesis); physical persistence; recognition; design-grade conditions (4)-(7).

allowed_claim: Over a finite rooted acyclic running-intersection cover, edge-compatible locally accepted pieces whose required conditions all pass glue to one global assignment that restricts to each piece.

The statement has no finiteness assumption at all (Index and Coord are arbitrary types); rootedness and rank are hypotheses that the proof does not use.
blocked_stronger_claim: Covers without running intersection glue (TTN-08 refutes this); global acceptance follows from gluing alone.

On the POS-04 model, a certificate derived by projecting the historical runtime to a finite factor instantiates the theorem for every genuine historical entry and every finite disturbance word.

allowed_claim: On a designed model with a finite physical factor and unbounded execution histories, in which all eight conditions are computed jointly from one installed execution at the interfaces fixed in advance, every successful request of the declared protocol yields three things from that same execution: least predictive ancestry from the source, realization of the whole computed set of conditions, and autonomy maintained by the target that preserves that realization. The protocol's successful requests cover both children of a fission, after the source is withdrawn and each child has completed its own local acquisition, and every fused output, after its own acquisition. They also cover their retained maintenance continuations. A freshly fused output does not yet have the package; it qualifies only after its own acquisition. The lineage here is predictive ancestry, which is weaker than strict live overlap.

Reading 2: a finite certificate with nonempty, universal full-history lifting. Unit disturbances with renewable retained ports. Generated birth and parent archives remain. The certificates are at different checkpoints, with no claim that they coexist. Cold fused outputs are charged but fail admission until acquisition.
